body: REDGARDEN commit a76e3d1. draw_char()'s hand-drawn font only covered digits + W,I,N,L,O,S,E,U,Y,H,P + space; everything else fell through to a generic missing-glyph box, much more visible now with tonight's hero-name expansion (Gary, Bacon+Puck, Abraham, Ada, Flute Debt). Added the remaining 15 uppercase letters, lowercase folding, and common punctuation. Verified via build_arena.sh, test_arena.sh, test_10_bots.sh, and a local mingw cross-compile, all clean. Closes BACKLOG S170-108.
title: Font glyph gap fixed -- 15 letters, lowercase, punctuation
